title: Screen Reader Task Audit — Finding extensions
description: Audit-specific extensions to the base finding schema (shared/schemas/finding.base.schema.json). Adds fields only; does not redefine or remove base fields. The Severity enum, Section, Load-displaced-to enum, and Evidence-state enum are inherited from the base schema unchanged.

at_browser_pairs.description: The assistive-technology + browser pairs on which this finding reproduced. Results are pair-dependent (e.g. aria-errormessage, modal containment, and route-change focus diverge across pairs), so the reproducing pairs are recorded per finding. Free-form labels; no fixed enum, because the relevant AT/browser matrix evolves. Examples: 'NVDA+Firefox', 'JAWS+Chrome', 'VoiceOver+Safari', 'VoiceOver iOS', 'TalkBack+Chrome'.
